!!!WARNING!!! Do not mess with the timing of this script starting
from MUSIC opcode. The music is synchronized to the slides.
If you MUST change timing of a subtitle, make sure this change is
balanced off by another subtitle within the same slide!
Everything is drawn within the clipping rect defined by DIMS, from 0, 0

Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI When I awoke, there was an angel
floating above me.
entries.source:
When I awoke, there was an angel
floating above me.
entries.translation:
我醒來時，看見一位天使
飄浮在上方。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI I knew I was dead.
entries.source: I knew I was dead.
entries.translation: 我知道自己已經死了。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI But if one HAS to die, I thought
to myself...
entries.source:
But if one HAS to die, I thought
to myself...
entries.translation:
但我心想，人如果非死不可
那麼……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...this was definitely the RIGHT
way to be dead.
entries.source:
...this was definitely the RIGHT
way to be dead.
entries.translation:
……這絕對是最正確的
死亡方式。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI That was about the time I heard
Talana's voice...
entries.source:
That was about the time I heard
Talana's voice...
entries.translation:
差不多就在這時，我聽見
塔拉娜的聲音……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...telling me to stop babbling
and listen for a moment.
entries.source:
...telling me to stop babbling
and listen for a moment.
entries.translation:
……叫我別再胡言亂語
先安靜聽她說。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI She told me that the escape pod
had almost been torn in half.
entries.source:
She told me that the escape pod
had almost been torn in half.
entries.translation:
她告訴我，逃生艙
差點被撕成兩半。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI I had been unconscious for over
three weeks...
entries.source:
I had been unconscious for over
three weeks...
entries.translation:
我已經昏迷了
三個多星期……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...but my crew and I had
succeeded in our mission!
entries.source:
...but my crew and I had
succeeded in our mission!
entries.translation:
……但我和船員
成功完成了任務！

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI The force of the explosion,
amplified by the Chmmr
crystals...
entries.source:
The force of the explosion,
amplified by the Chmmr
crystals...
entries.translation:
爆炸的威力
在克姆爾水晶的
增幅下……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...had been sufficient to
vaporize the Sa-Matra!
entries.source:
...had been sufficient to
vaporize the Sa-Matra!
entries.translation:
……已經足以
讓薩馬特拉化為蒸氣！

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI And following the destruction of
the Sa-Matra battle platform...
entries.source:
And following the destruction of
the Sa-Matra battle platform...
entries.translation:
而在薩馬特拉戰鬥平台
遭到摧毀後……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...the fleets of the Ur-Quan and
the Kohr-Ah had fallen into
chaos...
entries.source:
...the fleets of the Ur-Quan and
the Kohr-Ah had fallen into
chaos...
entries.translation:
……烏爾關與
克爾阿的艦隊
陷入混亂……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...and had been vanquished by
Chmmr forces and allied
starships.
entries.source:
...and had been vanquished by
Chmmr forces and allied
starships.
entries.translation:
……隨後遭到
克姆爾部隊與盟軍
星艦擊潰。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI Then Talana told me to sit up.
entries.source: Then Talana told me to sit up.
entries.translation: 接著塔拉娜叫我坐起來。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI She said there was something she
thought I'd like to see...
entries.source:
She said there was something she
thought I'd like to see...
entries.translation:
她說有樣東西
我應該會想看看……

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI I pulled myself up and looked
around...
entries.source:
I pulled myself up and looked
around...
entries.translation:
我撐起身子，望向
四周……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...I was in Sick Bay of the
Starbase, looking out over
Earth.
entries.source:
...I was in Sick Bay of the
Starbase, looking out over
Earth.
entries.translation:
……我人在星際基地的
醫務室，俯瞰著
地球。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Beneath me throbbed the sick red
glow of the Ur-Quan slave shield.
entries.source:
Beneath me throbbed the sick red
glow of the Ur-Quan slave shield.
entries.translation:
腳下跳動著烏爾關奴役護盾
病態的紅光。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Talana smiled and said that for
the past few days...
entries.source:
Talana smiled and said that for
the past few days...
entries.translation:
塔拉娜微笑著說，過去
幾天裡……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI the Chmmr had been working on
lowering the shield...
entries.source:
the Chmmr had been working on
lowering the shield...
entries.translation:
克姆爾一直在設法
解除護盾……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI and that it should be neutralized
right about... Now!
entries.source:
and that it should be neutralized
right about... Now!
entries.translation:
而它應該差不多會在
……現在！完全失效！

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI With a flare of incandescent
light, the slave shield
vanished...
entries.source:
With a flare of incandescent
light, the slave shield
vanished...
entries.translation:
伴隨一道熾白的
強光，奴役護盾
消失了……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...and for the first time in my
life I saw the true colors of
Earth...
entries.source:
...and for the first time in my
life I saw the true colors of
Earth...
entries.translation:
……生平第一次，我
親眼看見了地球真正的
色彩……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...blues and greens in a thousand
different shades.
entries.source:
...blues and greens in a thousand
different shades.
entries.translation:
……藍與綠，各自交織出
上千種不同色調。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI As we watched, we could see the
first signs of ships coming up
from Earth.
entries.source:
As we watched, we could see the
first signs of ships coming up
from Earth.
entries.translation:
我們看著看著，便發現
第一批船隻正從
地球升起。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI They lifted from the planet's
surface to join us in space.
entries.source:
They lifted from the planet's
surface to join us in space.
entries.translation:
它們從行星
表面升空，前來太空與我們 會合。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI The destiny of Mankind had been
delayed for over twenty years...
entries.source:
The destiny of Mankind had been
delayed for over twenty years...
entries.translation:
人類的命運已遭耽擱
二十多年……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...but now our world was free
and nothing could stop us!
entries.source:
...but now our world was free
and nothing could stop us!
entries.translation:
……但現在我們的世界自由 了
再也沒有什麼能阻擋我們！

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI I stayed in that hospital for
almost a month...
entries.source:
I stayed in that hospital for
almost a month...
entries.translation:
我在那間醫院裡住了
將近一個月……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.source: ...but that day...
entries.translation: ……但那一天……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI ...that day I watched the shield
fall and beautiful Talana stood
at my side...
entries.source:
...that day I watched the shield
fall and beautiful Talana stood
at my side...
entries.translation:
……那天，我看著護盾
消失，而美麗的塔拉娜就站 在
我身旁……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI I'll never forget that day. Not
for the rest of my life...
entries.source:
I'll never forget that day. Not
for the rest of my life...
entries.translation:
我永遠不會忘記那一天。 終此
一生都不會忘記……

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI But Grandfather then what
happened?
entries.source:
But Grandfather then what
happened?
entries.translation:
可是爺爺，後來
發生什麼事？

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI Yeah! How did you get home?
entries.source: Yeah! How did you get home?
entries.translation: 對啊！你怎麼回到家裡的？

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI How long did it take before you
and Grandma finally got married?
entries.source:
How long did it take before you
and Grandma finally got married?
entries.translation:
過了多久，你
和奶奶才終於結婚？

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Oh, while we intended to come
right home...
entries.source:
Oh, while we intended to come
right home...
entries.translation:
喔，雖然我們原本打算
直接回家……

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.source: ...we got a little sidetracked.
entries.translation: ……卻稍微繞了點遠路。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI Talana and I didn't make it back
here to Unzervalt until almost
five years later.
entries.source:
Talana and I didn't make it back
here to Unzervalt until almost
five years later.
entries.translation:
塔拉娜和我過了將近
五年，才回到這裡的
翁澤沃特。

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI But Grandfather! What happened?
Where did you go?
entries.source:
But Grandfather! What happened?
Where did you go?
entries.translation:
可是爺爺！發生了什麼事？
你們去了哪裡？

entries.label: Text fade-in
entries.body: TFI And how did you find the Mark II?
entries.source: And how did you find the Mark II?
entries.translation: 你又是怎麼找到二型艦的？

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
Text fade-in
entries.body:
TFI That, my children, is an entirely
different story.
entries.source:
That, my children, is an entirely
different story.
entries.translation:
孩子們，那完全是
另一個故事了。

entries.label: Fade slide to black; param1=fade time
